data.name: Aayesha
data.gender_notes: Aayesha is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is living or existing. The name Aayesha carries the meaning “Living one” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Aayesha usually hope their child will grow to embody living one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the presence of Allah (God) in every moment of life
data.etymology: Aayesha belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Living one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aayesha total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: أَايِشَة
in_arabic.meaning: أَغَرّ الأَزواج، المرأة التي كانت زوجة النبي محمد، والدة زينب بنت محمد
in_arabic.long_meaning: أَايِشَةُ بنتُ أبي بكرٍ الصديق، هيَ زوجَة النبي محمد، وَوالِدة زَيْنَب بنتِهِ، تُعتَبَر في الإسلام إحدى الصَحَابات الرُبَع، وَهَيَ المرأة التي نالَها النبي محمد بِخَطبَة مَرَّةً وَرُدَّةً، فَتُعتَبَر من أَولى الزوجات في الإسلام، وَإِنَّها أَولى الأَزواج بعد خَدِيجَة، وَهَيَ أَخُذها النبي محمد بِعِقد النِكاح في السَنَة الثامنة لِحِقرة، وَكَفَت فِعلَة النبِي صَلَواتُ الله عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَمَ في حَيّيها وَمَماتيها، وَهيَ تُعتَبَر في الإسلام بِمَنزِلَة مُستَحسَنَة، وَنُزِعَت مِنها النَفَس في السَنَة العاشرة لِحِقرة، بِأَموالٍ وَأَبناءٍ

in_urdu.name: اِیٰشہ
in_urdu.meaning: نبی صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کی زوجہ، اور ان کی بیٹی زینب
in_urdu.long_meaning: اِیٰشہ بنت ابی بکر صدیق، ایک اسلامی صحابیہ ہیں، اُن کی شادی نبی اکرم صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم نے ان کی والدہ کی خواہش پر عمل کر کے کی، اور ان کے ساتھ رشتہ ازدواج میں رہنے کے دوران نبی اکرم صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم سے بہت سارے احکامات نازل ہوئے، اور ان کا دور خلافت ایک خوشگوار دور ہے، اُن کی وفات 10ھ میں ہوئی، اور ان کی اہلیہ نے ان کے ساتھ وفات کے بعد بھی اپنی اہلیہ کے ساتھ ایک عجیب اور خوشگوار رشتہ قائم رکھا

in_hindi.name: आयेशा
in_hindi.meaning: पैगंबर सल्लल्लाहु अलैहे व सल्लम की पत्नी और उनकी पुत्री ज़ैनब
in_hindi.long_meaning: आयेशा बीबी अबू बकर सिद्दीक की पुत्री थीं, जिन्होंने नबी सल्लल्लाहु अलैहे व सल्लम के साथ विवाह किया था, और उनकी पुत्री ज़ैनब भी थीं जो पैगंबर सल्लल्लाहु अलैहे व सल्लम की पुत्री थीं। आयेशा बीबी ने अपने पति नबी सल्लल्लाहु अलैहे व सल्लम के साथ زندگی के دوران बहुत से احکामات پ्राप्त किए, जो اسلامی احکामों की وجوه हैं और उनकी وفत 10ھ में हुई, जो एक खुशगवार और उत्तम دور है, और उनकी पत्नी ने उनके देहांत के बाद भी अपने पति के साथ खुशगवार और अत्याधुनिक संबंध बनाए रखे

in_english.name: Aayesha
in_english.meaning: Prophet Muhammad's wife and daughter Zainab
in_english.long_meaning: Aayesha bint Abu Bakr, a prominent Sahabiyya in Islam, was the wife of the Prophet Muhammad and the mother of his daughter Zainab. She was one of the first women to embrace Islam and was married to the Prophet in 1 AH. Aayesha bint Abu Bakr was a prominent figure in Islamic history, and her marriage to the Prophet was a significant event in Islamic history. She was known for her intelligence, courage, and strong will, and was often referred to as the "mother of the faithful". Aayesha bint Abu Bakr played a significant role in the development of Islamic jurisprudence, and her opinions on Islamic law were highly respected. She was also known for her piety, charity, and good deeds, and was often referred to as the "mother of the believers".

data.cultural_impact: The name Aayesha hold great significance in Islamic history and culture. Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) married Aisha bint Abu Bakr (radi Allahu anha), who is renowned for her wisdom, beauty, intelligence, and grace. She was also a respected scholar of Islam, narrating numerous authentic Hadiths. The name Aisha is also popularly used among Muslims, not only as a personal name but also as a title of respect.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, the name Aayesha holds the symbolic meaning of being a living testament to the love and devotion of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) towards the sublime teachings of Islam. Aisha's unwavering faith, piety, and dedication are an inspiration for Muslims around the world to strive for a closer relationship with Allah (swt) and to propagate the authentic teachings of Islam. Her name serves as a reminder of the steadfastness and commitment required to live a purposeful and righteous life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Living one" symbolizes The one who is living or existing. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Aayesha serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of living one.
